```{r}
as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) {
    return(replace(x, is.na(x), FALSE))
  }

  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(!is.na(x) & x != 0)
  }

  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in%
    c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")
}

safe_divide <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(denominator) | denominator == 0,
    NA_real_,
    numerator / denominator
  )
}

write_empty_csv <- function(file, columns) {
  empty <- as.data.frame(
    setNames(
      replicate(
        length(columns),
        character(0),
        simplify = FALSE
      ),
      columns
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    empty,
    file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
resolve_existing_file <- function(
    explicit_file,
    candidate_files = character(),
    search_roots = character(),
    search_pattern = "(?i)mirna.*count.*\\.csv$",
    dataset_name
) {
  explicit_valid <-
    length(explicit_file) == 1 &&
    !is.null(explicit_file) &&
    !is.na(explicit_file) &&
    nzchar(trimws(as.character(explicit_file)))

  if (explicit_valid) {
    explicit_file <- path.expand(
      as.character(explicit_file)
    )

    if (!file.exists(explicit_file)) {
      stop(
        dataset_name,
        " file specified in YAML does not exist: ",
        explicit_file
      )
    }

    return(normalizePath(explicit_file))
  }

  candidate_files <- unique(
    path.expand(candidate_files)
  )

  candidates_found <- candidate_files[
    file.exists(candidate_files)
  ]

  searchable_roots <- search_roots[
    dir.exists(search_roots)
  ]

  discovered_files <- unique(
    unlist(
      lapply(
        searchable_roots,
        function(root) {
          list.files(
            root,
            pattern = search_pattern,
            recursive = TRUE,
            full.names = TRUE
          )
        }
      ),
      use.names = FALSE
    )
  )

  
  discovered_files <- discovered_files[
    !grepl(
      "DE_results|stability|bootstrap|primary_DE|sig_genes",
      discovered_files,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]

  all_found <- unique(
    c(
      candidates_found,
      discovered_files
    )
  )

  if (length(all_found) == 1) {
    message(
      "Automatically selected ",
      dataset_name,
      " file: ",
      all_found
    )

    return(normalizePath(all_found))
  }

  if (length(all_found) == 0) {
    stop(
      "Could not find the ",
      dataset_name,
      " file. Set the corresponding YAML parameter explicitly."
    )
  }

  stop(
    "Several possible ",
    dataset_name,
    " files were found. Set the YAML parameter explicitly:\n",
    paste(all_found, collapse = "\n")
  )
}
```

```{r}
normalize_tcga_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))

  
  
  is_tcga <- grepl(
    "^TCGA-[A-Za-z0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z0-9]{4}",
    x
  )

  x[is_tcga] <- substr(
    x[is_tcga],
    1,
    16
  )

  x
}
```

```{r}
read_clinical_data <- function(
    file,
    dataset_name,
    output_dir
) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " clinical file does not exist: ",
      file
    )
  }

  clinical <- read.csv(
    file,
    header = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
    na.strings = c("NA", "")
  )

  required_columns <- c(
    "sample_submitter_id",
    "MSI_TMB"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(clinical)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " clinical file is missing columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  clinical$sample_submitter_id_original <-
    clinical$sample_submitter_id

  clinical$sample_submitter_id <-
    normalize_tcga_sample_id(
      clinical$sample_submitter_id
    )

  duplicate_clinical <- clinical %>%
    count(
      sample_submitter_id,
      name = "Number_of_rows"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      Number_of_rows > 1
    )

  write.csv(
    duplicate_clinical,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "duplicated_clinical_sample_ids.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  if (nrow(duplicate_clinical) > 0) {
    warning(
      dataset_name,
      ": duplicated clinical sample IDs were found after barcode normalization. ",
      "The first row for each sample is retained."
    )

    clinical <- clinical[
      !duplicated(clinical$sample_submitter_id),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }

  group_mapping <- c(
    "MSI-H" = "MSI_H",
    "MSI_H" = "MSI_H",
    "MSS/TMB-H" = "MSS_TMB_H",
    "MSS_TMB_H" = "MSS_TMB_H",
    "MSS/TMB-L" = "MSS_TMB_L",
    "MSS_TMB_L" = "MSS_TMB_L"
  )

  clinical$MSI_TMB_original <- clinical$MSI_TMB

  clinical$MSI_TMB <- unname(
    group_mapping[
      trimws(
        as.character(clinical$MSI_TMB)
      )
    ]
  )

  clinical$MSI_TMB <- factor(
    clinical$MSI_TMB,
    levels = c(
      "MSI_H",
      "MSS_TMB_H",
      "MSS_TMB_L"
    )
  )

  unsupported <- clinical[
    is.na(clinical$MSI_TMB),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  write.csv(
    unsupported,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "clinical_samples_removed_unsupported_group.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  clinical <- clinical[
    !is.na(clinical$MSI_TMB),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  rownames(clinical) <-
    clinical$sample_submitter_id

  clinical
}
```

```{r}
collapse_duplicate_sample_columns <- function(
    counts,
    dataset_name,
    output_dir
) {
  sample_ids <- colnames(counts)

  duplicate_ids <- unique(
    sample_ids[
      duplicated(sample_ids) |
        duplicated(sample_ids, fromLast = TRUE)
    ]
  )

  if (length(duplicate_ids) == 0) {
    write_empty_csv(
      file.path(
        output_dir,
        "duplicated_count_sample_columns_removed.csv"
      ),
      c(
        "Sample",
        "Original_column",
        "Library_size",
        "Action"
      )
    )

    return(counts)
  }

  duplicate_log <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      duplicate_ids,
      function(sample_id) {
        indices <- which(
          sample_ids == sample_id
        )

        library_sizes <- colSums(
          counts[
            ,
            indices,
            drop = FALSE
          ],
          na.rm = TRUE
        )

        retained_local <- which.max(
          library_sizes
        )

        tibble(
          Sample = sample_id,
          Original_column = indices,
          Library_size = as.numeric(
            library_sizes
          ),
          Action = ifelse(
            seq_along(indices) == retained_local,
            "retained_largest_library",
            "removed_duplicate"
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )

  write.csv(
    duplicate_log,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "duplicated_count_sample_columns_removed.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  retained_indices <- unlist(
    lapply(
      unique(sample_ids),
      function(sample_id) {
        indices <- which(
          sample_ids == sample_id
        )

        if (length(indices) == 1) {
          return(indices)
        }

        library_sizes <- colSums(
          counts[
            ,
            indices,
            drop = FALSE
          ],
          na.rm = TRUE
        )

        indices[
          which.max(library_sizes)
        ]
      }
    ),
    use.names = FALSE
  )

  message(
    dataset_name,
    ": removed ",
    ncol(counts) - length(retained_indices),
    " duplicated sample columns; retained the largest library for each sample."
  )

  counts <- counts[
    ,
    retained_indices,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  stopifnot(
    !anyDuplicated(colnames(counts))
  )

  counts
}

read_mirna_counts <- function(
    file,
    dataset_name,
    output_dir
) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " miRNA count file does not exist: ",
      file
    )
  }

  counts_df <- read.csv(
    file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  counts <- as.matrix(
    counts_df
  )

  suppressWarnings(
    storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric"
  )

  if (anyNA(counts)) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": count matrix contains missing or non-numeric values."
    )
  }

  if (any(counts < 0)) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": count matrix contains negative values."
    )
  }

  if (is.null(rownames(counts))) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": count matrix does not have pre-miRNA row names."
    )
  }

  original_feature_count <- nrow(counts)

  if (anyDuplicated(rownames(counts))) {
    duplicated_features <- tibble(
      pre_miRNA = unique(
        rownames(counts)[
          duplicated(rownames(counts)) |
            duplicated(
              rownames(counts),
              fromLast = TRUE
            )
        ]
      )
    )

    write.csv(
      duplicated_features,
      file.path(
        output_dir,
        "duplicated_pre_miRNA_rows_collapsed.csv"
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    counts <- rowsum(
      counts,
      group = rownames(counts),
      reorder = FALSE
    )

    message(
      dataset_name,
      ": collapsed ",
      original_feature_count - nrow(counts),
      " duplicated pre-miRNA rows by summing counts."
    )
  } else {
    write_empty_csv(
      file.path(
        output_dir,
        "duplicated_pre_miRNA_rows_collapsed.csv"
      ),
      "pre_miRNA"
    )
  }

  colnames(counts) <-
    normalize_tcga_sample_id(
      colnames(counts)
    )

  counts <- collapse_duplicate_sample_columns(
    counts = counts,
    dataset_name = dataset_name,
    output_dir = output_dir
  )

  counts
}
```

```{r}
fit_edger_model <- function(
    counts_mat,
    metadata,
    genes_to_keep = NULL,
    min_count = 5
) {
  stopifnot(
    identical(
      colnames(counts_mat),
      rownames(metadata)
    )
  )

  expected_levels <- c(
    "MSI_H",
    "MSS_TMB_H",
    "MSS_TMB_L"
  )

  group <- factor(
    as.character(metadata$MSI_TMB),
    levels = expected_levels
  )

  if (anyNA(group)) {
    stop(
      "Some samples have an unsupported MSI_TMB group."
    )
  }

  current_group_sizes <- table(
    group
  )

  if (any(current_group_sizes == 0)) {
    stop(
      "At least one MSI/TMB group is absent."
    )
  }

  y <- edgeR::DGEList(
    counts = counts_mat,
    group = group
  )

  if (is.null(genes_to_keep)) {
    keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(
      y,
      group = group,
      min.count = min_count
    )
  } else {
    keep <-
      rownames(y) %in% genes_to_keep &
      rowSums(y$counts) > 0
  }

  y <- y[
    keep,
    ,
    keep.lib.sizes = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(y) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No pre-miRNAs remain after expression filtering."
    )
  }

  y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(
    y,
    method = "TMM"
  )

  design <- stats::model.matrix(
    ~ 0 + group
  )

  colnames(design) <- levels(
    group
  )

  y <- edgeR::estimateDisp(
    y,
    design,
    robust = TRUE
  )

  fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(
    y,
    design,
    robust = TRUE
  )

  contrasts <- list(
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H =
      limma::makeContrasts(
        MSI_H - MSS_TMB_H,
        levels = design
      ),

    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L =
      limma::makeContrasts(
        MSI_H - MSS_TMB_L,
        levels = design
      ),

    MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L =
      limma::makeContrasts(
        MSS_TMB_H - MSS_TMB_L,
        levels = design
      )
  )

  list(
    y = y,
    fit = fit,
    design = design,
    contrasts = contrasts,
    kept_genes = rownames(y)
  )
}

extract_contrast_results <- function(
    model_object
) {
  lapply(
    model_object$contrasts,
    function(contrast_vector) {
      qlf <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(
        model_object$fit,
        contrast = contrast_vector
      )

      edgeR::topTags(
        qlf,
        n = Inf,
        sort.by = "PValue"
      )$table
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
stratified_bootstrap_indices <- function(
    group
) {
  group <- droplevels(
    group
  )

  unlist(
    lapply(
      levels(group),
      function(group_name) {
        available_indices <- which(
          group == group_name
        )

        sample(
          available_indices,
          size = length(available_indices),
          replace = TRUE
        )
      }
    ),
    use.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
run_resampling_analysis <- function(
    index_list,
    resample_names,
    counts_mat,
    metadata,
    genes_to_keep,
    target_genes,
    contrasts_to_test,
    fdr_cutoff = 0.05
) {
  n_resamples <- length(index_list)

  if (length(resample_names) != n_resamples) {
    stop("resample_names and index_list must have the same length.")
  }

  missing_contrasts <- setdiff(
    contrasts_to_test,
    names(target_genes)
  )

  if (length(missing_contrasts) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing target-gene entries for contrasts: ",
      paste(missing_contrasts, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  logFC_matrices <- setNames(
    lapply(
      contrasts_to_test,
      function(contrast_name) {
        genes <- target_genes[[contrast_name]]

        matrix(
          NA_real_,
          nrow = length(genes),
          ncol = n_resamples,
          dimnames = list(
            genes,
            resample_names
          )
        )
      }
    ),
    contrasts_to_test
  )

  FDR_matrices <- setNames(
    lapply(
      contrasts_to_test,
      function(contrast_name) {
        genes <- target_genes[[contrast_name]]

        matrix(
          NA_real_,
          nrow = length(genes),
          ncol = n_resamples,
          dimnames = list(
            genes,
            resample_names
          )
        )
      }
    ),
    contrasts_to_test
  )

  total_DE <- matrix(
    NA_integer_,
    nrow = n_resamples,
    ncol = length(contrasts_to_test),
    dimnames = list(
      resample_names,
      contrasts_to_test
    )
  )

  failure_messages <- rep(
    NA_character_,
    n_resamples
  )

  for (i in seq_len(n_resamples)) {
    sample_indices <- index_list[[i]]

    if (
      length(sample_indices) == 0 ||
      anyNA(sample_indices)
    ) {
      failure_messages[i] <-
        "Empty or invalid sample-index vector."

      next
    }

    counts_i <- counts_mat[
      genes_to_keep,
      sample_indices,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    metadata_i <- metadata[
      sample_indices,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    
    
    unique_names <- paste0(
      "resample_",
      i,
      "_sample_",
      seq_len(ncol(counts_i))
    )

    colnames(counts_i) <- unique_names
    rownames(metadata_i) <- unique_names

    model_i <- tryCatch(
      fit_edger_model(
        counts_mat = counts_i,
        metadata = metadata_i,
        genes_to_keep = genes_to_keep,
        min_count = params$min_count
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )

    if (inherits(model_i, "error")) {
      failure_messages[i] <-
        conditionMessage(model_i)

      next
    }

    for (contrast_name in contrasts_to_test) {
      if (
        !contrast_name %in%
          names(model_i$contrasts)
      ) {
        failure_messages[i] <- paste0(
          "Contrast missing from fitted model: ",
          contrast_name
        )

        next
      }

      qlf_i <- tryCatch(
        edgeR::glmQLFTest(
          model_i$fit,
          contrast =
            model_i$contrasts[[contrast_name]]
        ),
        error = function(e) e
      )

      if (inherits(qlf_i, "error")) {
        failure_messages[i] <- paste0(
          contrast_name,
          ": ",
          conditionMessage(qlf_i)
        )

        next
      }

      tab_i <- qlf_i$table

      tab_i$FDR <- p.adjust(
        tab_i$PValue,
        method = "BH"
      )

      total_DE[i, contrast_name] <- sum(
        !is.na(tab_i$FDR) &
          tab_i$FDR <= fdr_cutoff
      )

      genes <- target_genes[[contrast_name]]

      if (length(genes) == 0) {
        next
      }

      gene_positions <- match(
        genes,
        rownames(tab_i)
      )

      found <- !is.na(gene_positions)

      if (any(found)) {
        logFC_matrices[[contrast_name]][found, i] <-
          tab_i$logFC[
            gene_positions[found]
          ]

        FDR_matrices[[contrast_name]][found, i] <-
          tab_i$FDR[
            gene_positions[found]
          ]
      }
    }
  }

  list(
    logFC = logFC_matrices,
    FDR = FDR_matrices,
    total_DE = total_DE,
    failures = failure_messages
  )
}


run_resampling_parallel <- function(
    index_list,
    resample_names,
    counts_mat,
    metadata,
    genes_to_keep,
    target_genes,
    contrasts_to_test,
    fdr_cutoff,
    n_workers,
    batch_size,
    random_seed
) {
  n_resamples <- length(index_list)

  if (n_resamples == 0) {
    stop("No resamples were supplied.")
  }

  if (length(resample_names) != n_resamples) {
    stop(
      "resample_names and index_list must have the same length."
    )
  }

  available_cores <- parallel::detectCores(
    logical = FALSE
  )

  if (
    is.na(available_cores) ||
    available_cores < 1
  ) {
    available_cores <- 1L
  }

  n_workers <- max(
    1L,
    min(
      as.integer(n_workers),
      as.integer(available_cores),
      n_resamples
    )
  )

  batch_size <- max(
    1L,
    as.integer(batch_size)
  )

  batch_ids <- split(
    seq_len(n_resamples),
    ceiling(
      seq_len(n_resamples) /
        batch_size
    )
  )

  message(
    "Running ",
    n_resamples,
    " resamples using ",
    n_workers,
    " workers in ",
    length(batch_ids),
    " batches."
  )

  if (
    .Platform$OS.type == "unix" &&
    n_workers > 1
  ) {
    bp <- BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(
      workers = n_workers,
      RNGseed = as.integer(random_seed),
      progressbar = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    bp <- BiocParallel::SerialParam(
      RNGseed = as.integer(random_seed),
      progressbar = TRUE
    )
  }

  parts <- BiocParallel::bplapply(
    batch_ids,
    function(ids) {
      run_resampling_analysis(
        index_list = index_list[ids],
        resample_names = resample_names[ids],
        counts_mat = counts_mat,
        metadata = metadata,
        genes_to_keep = genes_to_keep,
        target_genes = target_genes,
        contrasts_to_test = contrasts_to_test,
        fdr_cutoff = fdr_cutoff
      )
    },
    BPPARAM = bp
  )

  logFC_combined <- setNames(
    lapply(
      contrasts_to_test,
      function(contrast_name) {
        matrices <- lapply(
          parts,
          function(x) {
            x$logFC[[contrast_name]]
          }
        )

        combined <- do.call(
          cbind,
          matrices
        )

        colnames(combined) <- resample_names
        combined
      }
    ),
    contrasts_to_test
  )

  FDR_combined <- setNames(
    lapply(
      contrasts_to_test,
      function(contrast_name) {
        matrices <- lapply(
          parts,
          function(x) {
            x$FDR[[contrast_name]]
          }
        )

        combined <- do.call(
          cbind,
          matrices
        )

        colnames(combined) <- resample_names
        combined
      }
    ),
    contrasts_to_test
  )

  total_DE_combined <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      parts,
      function(x) {
        x$total_DE
      }
    )
  )

  rownames(total_DE_combined) <-
    resample_names

  failure_messages <- unlist(
    lapply(
      parts,
      function(x) {
        x$failures
      }
    ),
    use.names = FALSE
  )

  names(failure_messages) <-
    resample_names

  list(
    logFC = logFC_combined,
    FDR = FDR_combined,
    total_DE = total_DE_combined,
    failures = failure_messages
  )
}
```

```{r}
safe_quantile <- function(x, probability) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  unname(
    stats::quantile(
      x,
      probs = probability,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      type = 6
    )
  )
}


safe_median <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  stats::median(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}


summarize_resampling <- function(
    resampling_results,
    full_results,
    target_genes,
    method_name,
    fdr_cutoff,
    sign_consistency_cutoff,
    repeated_significance_cutoff
) {
  contrast_names <- names(target_genes)

  if (is.null(contrast_names)) {
    stop("target_genes must be a named list.")
  }

  missing_logfc <- setdiff(
    contrast_names,
    names(resampling_results$logFC)
  )

  missing_fdr <- setdiff(
    contrast_names,
    names(resampling_results$FDR)
  )

  missing_full <- setdiff(
    contrast_names,
    names(full_results)
  )

  if (length(missing_logfc) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing logFC matrices for contrasts: ",
      paste(missing_logfc, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (length(missing_fdr) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing FDR matrices for contrasts: ",
      paste(missing_fdr, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (length(missing_full) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing primary results for contrasts: ",
      paste(missing_full, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  summaries <- lapply(
    contrast_names,
    function(contrast_name) {
      genes <- target_genes[[contrast_name]]

      if (length(genes) == 0) {
        return(tibble::tibble())
      }

      logFC_matrix <-
        resampling_results$logFC[[contrast_name]]

      FDR_matrix <-
        resampling_results$FDR[[contrast_name]]

      if (!is.matrix(logFC_matrix)) {
        logFC_matrix <- as.matrix(logFC_matrix)
      }

      if (!is.matrix(FDR_matrix)) {
        FDR_matrix <- as.matrix(FDR_matrix)
      }

      if (!identical(dim(logFC_matrix), dim(FDR_matrix))) {
        stop(
          "logFC and FDR matrices have different dimensions for contrast: ",
          contrast_name
        )
      }

      if (ncol(logFC_matrix) == 0) {
        stop(
          "No resampling columns were found for contrast: ",
          contrast_name
        )
      }

      full_result_table <-
        full_results[[contrast_name]]

      gene_positions <- match(
        genes,
        rownames(full_result_table)
      )

      if (anyNA(gene_positions)) {
        missing_genes <- genes[
          is.na(gene_positions)
        ]

        stop(
          "Some target pre-miRNAs are missing from the primary result for ",
          contrast_name,
          ": ",
          paste(
            head(missing_genes, 20),
            collapse = ", "
          )
        )
      }

      full_table <- full_result_table[
        gene_positions,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

      rownames(full_table) <- genes

      full_logFC <- as.numeric(
        full_table$logFC
      )

      full_FDR <- as.numeric(
        full_table$FDR
      )

      
      logFC_positions <- match(
        genes,
        rownames(logFC_matrix)
      )

      FDR_positions <- match(
        genes,
        rownames(FDR_matrix)
      )

      if (
        anyNA(logFC_positions) ||
        anyNA(FDR_positions)
      ) {
        stop(
          "Some target pre-miRNAs are missing from the resampling matrices for ",
          contrast_name
        )
      }

      logFC_matrix <- logFC_matrix[
        logFC_positions,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

      FDR_matrix <- FDR_matrix[
        FDR_positions,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

      valid_result <-
        !is.na(logFC_matrix) &
        !is.na(FDR_matrix)

      same_direction <- sweep(
        sign(logFC_matrix),
        MARGIN = 1,
        STATS = sign(full_logFC),
        FUN = "=="
      )

      significant <-
        !is.na(FDR_matrix) &
        FDR_matrix <= fdr_cutoff

      n_tested <- rowSums(
        valid_result,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

      sign_consistency <- ifelse(
        n_tested > 0,
        rowSums(
          same_direction & valid_result,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) / n_tested,
        NA_real_
      )

      FDR_rate <- ifelse(
        n_tested > 0,
        rowSums(
          significant & valid_result,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) / n_tested,
        NA_real_
      )

      FDR_same_direction_rate <- ifelse(
        n_tested > 0,
        rowSums(
          significant &
            same_direction &
            valid_result,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) / n_tested,
        NA_real_
      )

      median_logFC <- apply(
        logFC_matrix,
        MARGIN = 1,
        FUN = safe_median
      )

      logFC_q025 <- apply(
        logFC_matrix,
        MARGIN = 1,
        FUN = safe_quantile,
        probability = 0.025
      )

      logFC_q975 <- apply(
        logFC_matrix,
        MARGIN = 1,
        FUN = safe_quantile,
        probability = 0.975
      )

      direction_stable <- (
        !is.na(logFC_q025) &
        !is.na(logFC_q975) &
        logFC_q025 > 0 &
        logFC_q975 > 0
      ) | (
        !is.na(logFC_q025) &
        !is.na(logFC_q975) &
        logFC_q025 < 0 &
        logFC_q975 < 0
      )

      tested_rate <-
        n_tested / ncol(logFC_matrix)

      robust_effect <- (
        !is.na(tested_rate) &
        tested_rate >= 0.95 &
        !is.na(sign_consistency) &
        sign_consistency >= sign_consistency_cutoff &
        direction_stable
      )

      repeatedly_significant <- (
        !is.na(FDR_same_direction_rate) &
        FDR_same_direction_rate >=
          repeated_significance_cutoff
      )

      tibble::tibble(
        Contrast = contrast_name,
        pre_miRNA = genes,
        Method = method_name,
        n_resamples = ncol(logFC_matrix),
        n_tested = n_tested,
        tested_rate = tested_rate,
        full_logFC = full_logFC,
        full_FDR = full_FDR,
        resampled_median_logFC = median_logFC,
        resampled_logFC_q025 = logFC_q025,
        resampled_logFC_q975 = logFC_q975,
        sign_consistency = sign_consistency,
        FDR_rate = FDR_rate,
        FDR_same_direction_rate =
          FDR_same_direction_rate,
        direction_stable = direction_stable,
        robust_effect = robust_effect,
        repeatedly_significant =
          repeatedly_significant
      )
    }
  )

  dplyr::bind_rows(summaries)
}
```

```{r}
run_mirna_stability_analysis <- function(
    dataset_name,
    clinical_file,
    counts_file
) {
  message(
    "\n========================================\n",
    "Starting ", dataset_name,
    " pre-miRNA stability analysis\n",
    "========================================"
  )

  dataset_dir <- file.path(
    params$output_root,
    dataset_name
  )

  primary_dir <- file.path(
    dataset_dir,
    "primary_DE"
  )

  stability_dir <- file.path(
    dataset_dir,
    "stability_analysis"
  )

  figure_dir <- file.path(
    dataset_dir,
    "figures"
  )

  fs::dir_create(
    c(
      dataset_dir,
      primary_dir,
      stability_dir,
      figure_dir
    )
  )

  
  
  

  clinical <- read_clinical_data(
    file = clinical_file,
    dataset_name = dataset_name,
    output_dir = stability_dir
  )

  counts <- read_mirna_counts(
    file = counts_file,
    dataset_name = dataset_name,
    output_dir = stability_dir
  )

  common_samples <- intersect(
    colnames(counts),
    rownames(clinical)
  )

  if (length(common_samples) == 0) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": no sample names are shared by the count matrix and clinical data."
    )
  }

  counts <- counts[
    ,
    common_samples,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  clinical <- clinical[
    common_samples,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (!identical(colnames(counts), rownames(clinical))) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": counts and clinical sample orders do not match."
    )
  }

  group_sizes <- table(
    clinical$MSI_TMB,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )

  required_groups <- c(
    "MSI_H",
    "MSS_TMB_H",
    "MSS_TMB_L"
  )

  missing_groups <- setdiff(
    required_groups,
    names(group_sizes)
  )

  if (length(missing_groups) > 0) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": missing MSI/TMB groups: ",
      paste(missing_groups, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (any(group_sizes[required_groups] == 0)) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": at least one required MSI/TMB group has no matched samples."
    )
  }

  group_size_table <- tibble::tibble(
    Dataset = dataset_name,
    Group = names(group_sizes),
    Number_of_samples = as.integer(group_sizes)
  )

  write.csv(
    group_size_table,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "group_sizes.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    clinical,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "clinical_data_used.csv"
    ),
    row.names = TRUE
  )

  write.csv(
    tibble::tibble(
      pre_miRNA = rownames(counts)
    ),
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "pre_miRNAs_before_expression_filtering.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  
  
  

  primary_model <- fit_edger_model(
    counts_mat = counts,
    metadata = clinical,
    min_count = params$min_count
  )

  primary_results <- extract_contrast_results(
    primary_model
  )

  saveRDS(
    primary_model,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "primary_edgeR_model.rds"
    )
  )

  writeLines(
    primary_model$kept_genes,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "pre_miRNAs_tested_primary_analysis.txt"
    )
  )

  for (contrast_name in names(primary_results)) {
    write.csv(
      primary_results[[contrast_name]],
      file.path(
        primary_dir,
        paste0(
          contrast_name,
          ".csv"
        )
      )
    )
  }

  primary_significant <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      names(primary_results),
      function(contrast_name) {
        primary_results[[contrast_name]] %>%
          tibble::rownames_to_column(
            "pre_miRNA"
          ) %>%
          tibble::as_tibble() %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            !is.na(FDR),
            FDR <= params$fdr_threshold
          ) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            Dataset = dataset_name,
            Contrast = contrast_name,
            Direction = dplyr::case_when(
              logFC > 0 ~ "Up_in_first_group",
              logFC < 0 ~ "Down_in_first_group",
              TRUE ~ "No_change"
            ),
            Passes_logFC_cutoff =
              abs(logFC) >= params$logfc_threshold,
            .before = 1
          )
      }
    )
  )

  write.csv(
    primary_significant,
    file.path(
      primary_dir,
      "all_primary_significant_pre_miRNAs.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  
  
  

  missing_stability_contrasts <- setdiff(
    stability_contrasts,
    names(primary_results)
  )

  if (length(missing_stability_contrasts) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing primary results for contrasts: ",
      paste(
        missing_stability_contrasts,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  target_genes <- lapply(
    primary_results[stability_contrasts],
    function(result_table) {
      rownames(result_table)[
        !is.na(result_table$FDR) &
          result_table$FDR <= params$fdr_threshold
      ]
    }
  )

  target_counts <- tibble::tibble(
    Dataset = dataset_name,
    Contrast = names(target_genes),
    Number_of_primary_significant = vapply(
      target_genes,
      length,
      integer(1)
    )
  )

  write.csv(
    target_counts,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "target_pre_miRNA_counts.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  
  
  

  dataset_seed_offset <- match(
    dataset_name,
    c("CRC", "UCEC")
  )

  if (is.na(dataset_seed_offset)) {
    dataset_seed_offset <- 0L
  }

  dataset_seed <- as.integer(
    params$random_seed
  ) + as.integer(dataset_seed_offset)

  set.seed(dataset_seed)

  B <- as.integer(
    params$bootstrap_iterations
  )

  if (is.na(B) || B < 1L) {
    stop(
      "bootstrap_iterations must be at least 1."
    )
  }

  bootstrap_index_list <- replicate(
    B,
    stratified_bootstrap_indices(
      clinical$MSI_TMB
    ),
    simplify = FALSE
  )

  bootstrap_names <- sprintf(
    "bootstrap_%04d",
    seq_len(B)
  )

  bootstrap_results <- run_resampling_parallel(
    index_list = bootstrap_index_list,
    resample_names = bootstrap_names,
    counts_mat = counts,
    metadata = clinical,
    genes_to_keep = primary_model$kept_genes,
    target_genes = target_genes,
    contrasts_to_test = stability_contrasts,
    fdr_cutoff = params$fdr_threshold,
    n_workers = params$parallel_workers,
    batch_size = params$bootstrap_batch_size,
    random_seed = dataset_seed
  )

  saveRDS(
    bootstrap_results,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "bootstrap_results.rds"
    )
  )

  bootstrap_failures <- as.character(
    bootstrap_results$failures
  )

  if (length(bootstrap_failures) != length(bootstrap_names)) {
    stop(
      "The number of bootstrap failure records does not match ",
      "the number of bootstrap resamples."
    )
  }

  bootstrap_failure_table <- tibble::tibble(
    Resample = bootstrap_names,
    Failure = bootstrap_failures
  )

  write.csv(
    bootstrap_failure_table,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "bootstrap_failures.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  bootstrap_summary <- summarize_resampling(
    resampling_results = bootstrap_results,
    full_results = primary_results,
    target_genes = target_genes,
    method_name = "Stratified bootstrap",
    fdr_cutoff = params$fdr_threshold,
    sign_consistency_cutoff =
      params$sign_consistency_threshold,
    repeated_significance_cutoff =
      params$repeated_significance_threshold
  )

  write.csv(
    bootstrap_summary,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "bootstrap_pre_miRNA_stability_summary.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  
  
  

  mssh_group_size <- as.integer(
    group_sizes[["MSS_TMB_H"]]
  )

  run_loo <- isTRUE(
    as_flag(params$run_leave_one_out)
  ) && mssh_group_size >= 2L

  if (run_loo) {
    mssh_indices <- which(
      clinical$MSI_TMB == "MSS_TMB_H"
    )

    loo_index_list <- lapply(
      mssh_indices,
      function(omit_index) {
        setdiff(
          seq_len(ncol(counts)),
          omit_index
        )
      }
    )

    loo_names <- paste0(
      "leave_out_",
      colnames(counts)[mssh_indices]
    )

    loo_results <- run_resampling_parallel(
      index_list = loo_index_list,
      resample_names = loo_names,
      counts_mat = counts,
      metadata = clinical,
      genes_to_keep = primary_model$kept_genes,
      target_genes = target_genes,
      contrasts_to_test = stability_contrasts,
      fdr_cutoff = params$fdr_threshold,
      n_workers = params$parallel_workers,
      batch_size = params$bootstrap_batch_size,
      random_seed = dataset_seed + 1000L
    )

    saveRDS(
      loo_results,
      file.path(
        stability_dir,
        "leave_one_MSS_TMB_H_out_results.rds"
      )
    )

    loo_failures <- as.character(
      loo_results$failures
    )

    write.csv(
      tibble::tibble(
        Resample = loo_names,
        Failure = loo_failures
      ),
      file.path(
        stability_dir,
        "leave_one_out_failures.csv"
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    loo_summary <- summarize_resampling(
      resampling_results = loo_results,
      full_results = primary_results,
      target_genes = target_genes,
      method_name = "Leave-one-MSS/TMB-H-out",
      fdr_cutoff = params$fdr_threshold,
      sign_consistency_cutoff =
        params$sign_consistency_threshold,
      repeated_significance_cutoff =
        params$repeated_significance_threshold
    )
  } else {
    loo_results <- NULL
    loo_summary <- tibble::tibble()

    write_empty_csv(
      file.path(
        stability_dir,
        "leave_one_out_failures.csv"
      ),
      c(
        "Resample",
        "Failure"
      )
    )
  }

  write.csv(
    loo_summary,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "leave_one_out_pre_miRNA_stability_summary.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  
  
  

  if (nrow(bootstrap_summary) > 0) {
    bootstrap_wide <- bootstrap_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Contrast,
        pre_miRNA,
        bootstrap_tested_rate = tested_rate,
        bootstrap_median_logFC =
          resampled_median_logFC,
        bootstrap_logFC_q025 =
          resampled_logFC_q025,
        bootstrap_logFC_q975 =
          resampled_logFC_q975,
        bootstrap_sign_consistency =
          sign_consistency,
        bootstrap_FDR_rate = FDR_rate,
        bootstrap_FDR_same_direction_rate =
          FDR_same_direction_rate,
        bootstrap_direction_stable =
          direction_stable,
        bootstrap_robust_effect =
          robust_effect,
        bootstrap_repeatedly_significant =
          repeatedly_significant
      )
  } else {
    bootstrap_wide <- tibble::tibble(
      Contrast = character(),
      pre_miRNA = character(),
      bootstrap_tested_rate = numeric(),
      bootstrap_median_logFC = numeric(),
      bootstrap_logFC_q025 = numeric(),
      bootstrap_logFC_q975 = numeric(),
      bootstrap_sign_consistency = numeric(),
      bootstrap_FDR_rate = numeric(),
      bootstrap_FDR_same_direction_rate =
        numeric(),
      bootstrap_direction_stable = logical(),
      bootstrap_robust_effect = logical(),
      bootstrap_repeatedly_significant =
        logical()
    )
  }

  if (nrow(loo_summary) > 0) {
    loo_wide <- loo_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Contrast,
        pre_miRNA,
        loo_tested_rate = tested_rate,
        loo_median_logFC =
          resampled_median_logFC,
        loo_logFC_q025 =
          resampled_logFC_q025,
        loo_logFC_q975 =
          resampled_logFC_q975,
        loo_sign_consistency =
          sign_consistency,
        loo_FDR_rate = FDR_rate,
        loo_FDR_same_direction_rate =
          FDR_same_direction_rate,
        loo_direction_stable =
          direction_stable,
        loo_robust_effect = robust_effect,
        loo_repeatedly_significant =
          repeatedly_significant
      )
  } else {
    loo_wide <- tibble::tibble(
      Contrast = character(),
      pre_miRNA = character()
    )
  }

  
  
  

  full_target_information <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      stability_contrasts,
      function(contrast_name) {
        genes <- target_genes[[contrast_name]]

        if (length(genes) == 0) {
          return(tibble::tibble())
        }

        result_table <- primary_results[[contrast_name]]

        gene_positions <- match(
          genes,
          rownames(result_table)
        )

        if (anyNA(gene_positions)) {
          missing_genes <- genes[
            is.na(gene_positions)
          ]

          stop(
            "Target pre-miRNAs are missing from the primary table for ",
            contrast_name,
            ": ",
            paste(
              head(missing_genes, 20),
              collapse = ", "
            )
          )
        }

        result_table[
          gene_positions,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ] %>%
          tibble::rownames_to_column(
            "pre_miRNA"
          ) %>%
          tibble::as_tibble() %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            Dataset = dataset_name,
            Contrast = contrast_name,
            .before = 1
          )
      }
    )
  )

  
  
  

  combined_stability <- full_target_information %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      bootstrap_wide,
      by = c(
        "Contrast",
        "pre_miRNA"
      )
    )

  if (nrow(loo_wide) > 0) {
    combined_stability <- combined_stability %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        loo_wide,
        by = c(
          "Contrast",
          "pre_miRNA"
        )
      )
  } else {
    combined_stability <- combined_stability %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        loo_tested_rate = NA_real_,
        loo_median_logFC = NA_real_,
        loo_logFC_q025 = NA_real_,
        loo_logFC_q975 = NA_real_,
        loo_sign_consistency = NA_real_,
        loo_FDR_rate = NA_real_,
        loo_FDR_same_direction_rate =
          NA_real_,
        loo_direction_stable = NA,
        loo_robust_effect = NA,
        loo_repeatedly_significant = NA
      )
  }

  if (nrow(combined_stability) > 0) {
    combined_stability <- combined_stability %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        bootstrap_stable = dplyr::coalesce(
          bootstrap_robust_effect,
          FALSE
        ),

        bootstrap_stable_strict =
          dplyr::coalesce(
            bootstrap_robust_effect,
            FALSE
          ) &
          dplyr::coalesce(
            bootstrap_repeatedly_significant,
            FALSE
          ),

        stable_in_both_analyses =
          dplyr::case_when(
            is.na(loo_robust_effect) ~
              NA,

            TRUE ~
              bootstrap_stable &
              loo_robust_effect
          ),

        repeatedly_significant_in_both =
          dplyr::case_when(
            is.na(
              loo_repeatedly_significant
            ) ~ NA,

            TRUE ~
              dplyr::coalesce(
                bootstrap_repeatedly_significant,
                FALSE
              ) &
              loo_repeatedly_significant
          ),

        Primary_passes_logFC_cutoff =
          abs(logFC) >=
          params$logfc_threshold,

        Bootstrap_failure_reason =
          dplyr::case_when(
            bootstrap_stable ~
              "Passed bootstrap robust-effect criterion",

            is.na(bootstrap_tested_rate) ~
              "Missing bootstrap result",

            bootstrap_tested_rate < 0.95 ~
              "Tested in fewer than 95% of bootstrap samples",

            bootstrap_sign_consistency <
              params$sign_consistency_threshold &
              !bootstrap_direction_stable ~
              "Low sign consistency and interval crosses zero",

            bootstrap_sign_consistency <
              params$sign_consistency_threshold ~
              "Low sign consistency",

            !bootstrap_direction_stable ~
              "Bootstrap logFC interval crosses zero",

            TRUE ~
              "Did not pass bootstrap"
          )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        Contrast,
        FDR,
        dplyr::desc(abs(logFC))
      )
  } else {
    combined_stability$bootstrap_stable <-
      logical(0)

    combined_stability$bootstrap_stable_strict <-
      logical(0)

    combined_stability$stable_in_both_analyses <-
      logical(0)

    combined_stability$repeatedly_significant_in_both <-
      logical(0)

    combined_stability$Primary_passes_logFC_cutoff <-
      logical(0)

    combined_stability$Bootstrap_failure_reason <-
      character(0)
  }

  write.csv(
    combined_stability,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "combined_primary_bootstrap_LOO_pre_miRNA_stability.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  
  
  

  stable_pre_mirnas <- combined_stability %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      bootstrap_stable
    )

  strict_stable_pre_mirnas <- combined_stability %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      bootstrap_stable_strict
    )

  failed_pre_mirnas <- combined_stability %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !bootstrap_stable
    )

  write.csv(
    stable_pre_mirnas,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "bootstrap_stable_pre_miRNAs.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    strict_stable_pre_mirnas,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "bootstrap_strict_stable_pre_miRNAs.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    failed_pre_mirnas,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "primary_significant_pre_miRNAs_not_passing_bootstrap.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  
  
  

  stable_counts <- stable_pre_mirnas %>%
    dplyr::count(
      Contrast,
      name = "Bootstrap_robust_effect"
    )

  strict_counts <- strict_stable_pre_mirnas %>%
    dplyr::count(
      Contrast,
      name = "Bootstrap_strict_stable"
    )

  comparison_summary <- target_counts %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      stable_counts,
      by = "Contrast"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      strict_counts,
      by = "Contrast"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Bootstrap_robust_effect =
        dplyr::coalesce(
          Bootstrap_robust_effect,
          0L
        ),

      Bootstrap_strict_stable =
        dplyr::coalesce(
          Bootstrap_strict_stable,
          0L
        ),

      Not_passing_bootstrap =
        Number_of_primary_significant -
        Bootstrap_robust_effect,

      Retained_percent = round(
        100 * safe_divide(
          Bootstrap_robust_effect,
          Number_of_primary_significant
        ),
        2
      )
    )

  write.csv(
    comparison_summary,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "primary_vs_bootstrap_stable_counts.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  bootstrap_DE_counts <- as.data.frame(
    bootstrap_results$total_DE
  ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(
      "Resample"
    )

  write.csv(
    bootstrap_DE_counts,
    file.path(
      stability_dir,
      "bootstrap_number_of_significant_pre_miRNAs.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  
  
  

  count_plot_data <- comparison_summary %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Dataset,
      Contrast,
      Primary =
        Number_of_primary_significant,
      Bootstrap_robust =
        Bootstrap_robust_effect,
      Bootstrap_strict =
        Bootstrap_strict_stable
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(
        Primary,
        Bootstrap_robust,
        Bootstrap_strict
      ),
      names_to = "Analysis",
      values_to = "Number_of_pre_miRNAs"
    )

  p_counts <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    count_plot_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      Contrast,
      Number_of_pre_miRNAs,
      fill = Analysis
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(
      position =
        ggplot2::position_dodge(
          width = 0.8
        ),
      width = 0.72
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      ggplot2::aes(
        label =
          Number_of_pre_miRNAs
      ),
      position =
        ggplot2::position_dodge(
          width = 0.8
        ),
      vjust = -0.3,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        dataset_name,
        ": primary versus bootstrap-stable pre-miRNAs"
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of significant pre-miRNAs",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          angle = 25,
          hjust = 1
        ),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(
      figure_dir,
      "primary_vs_bootstrap_stable_counts.svg"
    ),
    p_counts,
    width = 9,
    height = 5.5,
    device = "svg"
  )

  
  
  

  if (nrow(bootstrap_summary) > 0) {
    p_logfc <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      bootstrap_summary,
      ggplot2::aes(
        full_logFC,
        resampled_median_logFC
      )
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(
        xintercept = 0,
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_abline(
        slope = 1,
        intercept = 0,
        linetype = "dotted"
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
        ggplot2::aes(
          ymin =
            resampled_logFC_q025,
          ymax =
            resampled_logFC_q975
        ),
        width = 0,
        alpha = 0.45
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        ggplot2::aes(
          shape =
            direction_stable,
          size =
            FDR_same_direction_rate
        ),
        alpha = 0.8
      ) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(
        ~ Contrast,
        scales = "free"
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste0(
          dataset_name,
          ": bootstrap stability of pre-miRNA effect sizes"
        ),
        x = "Primary logFC",
        y = "Median bootstrap logFC",
        shape =
          "95% interval excludes zero",
        size =
          "Significant in same direction"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_classic(
        base_size = 12
      )

    ggplot2::ggsave(
      file.path(
        figure_dir,
        "bootstrap_logFC_stability.svg"
      ),
      p_logfc,
      width = 10,
      height = 6,
      device = "svg"
    )

    stability_long <- bootstrap_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Contrast,
        pre_miRNA,
        Sign_consistency =
          sign_consistency,
        Repeated_significance =
          FDR_same_direction_rate
      ) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = c(
          Sign_consistency,
          Repeated_significance
        ),
        names_to = "Measure",
        values_to = "Rate"
      )

    p_rates <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      stability_long,
      ggplot2::aes(
        Rate,
        fill = Measure
      )
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_histogram(
        bins = 20,
        alpha = 0.65,
        position = "identity"
      ) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(
        ~ Contrast
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(
        xintercept = c(
          params$sign_consistency_threshold,
          params$repeated_significance_threshold
        ),
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste0(
          dataset_name,
          ": bootstrap stability-rate distributions"
        ),
        x = "Rate",
        y = "Number of pre-miRNAs",
        fill = NULL
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_classic(
        base_size = 12
      )

    ggplot2::ggsave(
      file.path(
        figure_dir,
        "bootstrap_stability_rate_distributions.svg"
      ),
      p_rates,
      width = 10,
      height = 6,
      device = "svg"
    )
  }

  
  
  

  excel_file <- file.path(
    dataset_dir,
    paste0(
      dataset_name,
      "_pre_miRNA_bootstrap_stability.xlsx"
    )
  )

  openxlsx::write.xlsx(
    list(
      Group_sizes =
        group_size_table,
      Primary_counts =
        target_counts,
      Primary_significant =
        primary_significant,
      Bootstrap_count_comparison =
        comparison_summary,
      Bootstrap_stability =
        bootstrap_summary,
      Combined_stability =
        combined_stability,
      Bootstrap_stable =
        stable_pre_mirnas,
      Strict_stable =
        strict_stable_pre_mirnas,
      Not_passing_bootstrap =
        failed_pre_mirnas,
      Bootstrap_failures =
        bootstrap_failure_table,
      LOO_stability =
        loo_summary
    ),
    file = excel_file,
    overwrite = TRUE
  )

  message(
    dataset_name,
    " analysis completed. Results saved to: ",
    dataset_dir
  )

  
  
  

  list(
    dataset = dataset_name,
    dataset_dir = dataset_dir,
    group_sizes = group_size_table,
    primary_results = primary_results,
    primary_significant =
      primary_significant,
    target_genes = target_genes,
    bootstrap_results =
      bootstrap_results,
    bootstrap_summary =
      bootstrap_summary,
    loo_results = loo_results,
    loo_summary = loo_summary,
    combined_stability =
      combined_stability,
    comparison_summary =
      comparison_summary,
    stable_pre_mirnas =
      stable_pre_mirnas,
    strict_stable_pre_mirnas =
      strict_stable_pre_mirnas,
    failed_pre_mirnas =
      failed_pre_mirnas
  )
}
```

```{r}
crc_stable <- crc_analysis$stable_pre_mirnas %>%
  select(
    Contrast,
    pre_miRNA,
    CRC_logFC = logFC,
    CRC_FDR = FDR,
    CRC_bootstrap_sign_consistency =
      bootstrap_sign_consistency,
    CRC_bootstrap_FDR_same_direction_rate =
      bootstrap_FDR_same_direction_rate,
    CRC_bootstrap_direction_stable =
      bootstrap_direction_stable
  )

ucec_stable <- ucec_analysis$stable_pre_mirnas %>%
  select(
    Contrast,
    pre_miRNA,
    UCEC_logFC = logFC,
    UCEC_FDR = FDR,
    UCEC_bootstrap_sign_consistency =
      bootstrap_sign_consistency,
    UCEC_bootstrap_FDR_same_direction_rate =
      bootstrap_FDR_same_direction_rate,
    UCEC_bootstrap_direction_stable =
      bootstrap_direction_stable
  )

shared_bootstrap_stable <- inner_join(
  crc_stable,
  ucec_stable,
  by = c(
    "Contrast",
    "pre_miRNA"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Direction_consistent =
      sign(CRC_logFC) ==
      sign(UCEC_logFC),

    Direction = case_when(
      Direction_consistent &
        CRC_logFC > 0 ~
        "Higher in first contrast group in both cancers",

      Direction_consistent &
        CRC_logFC < 0 ~
        "Lower in first contrast group in both cancers",

      TRUE ~
        "Opposite directions"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Contrast,
    desc(Direction_consistent),
    pmax(
      CRC_FDR,
      UCEC_FDR
    )
  )

write.csv(
  shared_bootstrap_stable,
  file.path(
    params$output_root,
    "shared_bootstrap_stable_pre_miRNAs_CRC_UCEC.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

shared_consistent <- shared_bootstrap_stable %>%
  filter(
    Direction_consistent
  )

write.csv(
  shared_consistent,
  file.path(
    params$output_root,
    "shared_direction_consistent_bootstrap_stable_pre_miRNAs_CRC_UCEC.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

shared_summary <- shared_bootstrap_stable %>%
  group_by(
    Contrast
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Shared_bootstrap_stable =
      n(),
    Shared_direction_consistent =
      sum(
        Direction_consistent
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  shared_summary,
  file.path(
    params$output_root,
    "shared_bootstrap_stable_pre_miRNA_counts_CRC_UCEC.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  shared_summary,
  caption = "Shared bootstrap-stable pre-miRNAs in CRC and UCEC."
)
```

```{r}
)

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  list(
    Count_summary =
      combined_count_summary,

    CRC_combined_stability =
      crc_analysis$combined_stability,

    UCEC_combined_stability =
      ucec_analysis$combined_stability,

    CRC_not_passing =
      crc_analysis$failed_pre_mirnas,

    UCEC_not_passing =
      ucec_analysis$failed_pre_mirnas,

    CRC_bootstrap_stable =
      crc_analysis$stable_pre_mirnas,

    UCEC_bootstrap_stable =
      ucec_analysis$stable_pre_mirnas,

    Shared_stable =
      shared_bootstrap_stable,

    Shared_consistent =
      shared_consistent,

    Shared_counts =
      shared_summary
  ),
  file =
    combined_excel_file,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat(
  "Combined Excel workbook:\n",
  combined_excel_file,
  "\n"
)
```
